quotes.quote: Humor is so important to the American scene throughout history.

quotes.quote: Jesus!"Luke exclaimed."Actually, it's just me,"said Simon. "Although I've been told the resemblance is startling.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare

quotes.quote: Certainly my personality, my sense of humor, my outlook on life was informed by the experiences of my parents and the stories they shared with me.
quotes.author: Geddy Lee

quotes.quote: To succeed in life, you need three things: a wishbone, a backbone and a funny bone.
quotes.author: Reba McEntire

quotes.quote: I'm interested in humor, and greeting cards just happen to be a perfect medium for my message. They're accessible to everyone, and thanks to all the advances that have been made by environmentally conscientious printers, I can get my message across while keeping my carbon footprint relatively small.
quotes.author: Anne Taintor

quotes.quote: Creativity is knowing how to hide your sources
quotes.author: C.E.M. Joad

quotes.quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: I think it's because it's so different and it takes risks. Plus, it's really smart humor. It gives the audience credit in terms of not needing to tell them when to laugh. I love that about the show. There's no laugh track.
quotes.author: Sarah Chalke

quotes.quote: The most terrible fear that anybody should have is not war, is not a disease, not cancer or heart problems or food poisoning - it's a man or a woman without a sense of humor.
quotes.author: Jonathan Winters

quotes.quote: The overwhelming majority of Americans are possessed of two great qualities a sense of humor and a sense of proportion.
quotes.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quotes.quote: It's easier to sit there and say you don't like feminists because they don't have a sense of humor.
quotes.author: Joan Jett

quotes.quote: If one tends to be a humorous person and you have a sense of humor the rest of your life then you can certainly lighten the load, I think, by bringing that to your trials and tribulations. It's easy to have a sense of humor when everything is going well.
quotes.author: Alan Thicke

quotes.quote: The statistics on sanity are that one out of every four people is suffering from a mental illness. Look at your 3 best friends. If they're ok, then it's you.
quotes.author: Rita Mae Brown

quotes.quote: Comedy is difficult for an actor. But I think I have a good sense of humor and manage to make people laugh and make them happy.
quotes.author: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan

quotes.quote: We do not take humor seriously enough.
quotes.author: Konrad Lorenz

quotes.quote: There is nothing like the way people feel after they've seen 'The Intouchables.' They feel amazing. The word of mouth on this film is incredible. It's intelligent-feeling good. You're not insulted by the low-browness or stupidity of some of the humor. It's so smart and terrific.
quotes.author: Harvey Weinstein

quotes.quote: I consider myself to have a decent sense of humor. What's life without a sense of humor?
quotes.author: Mayer Hawthorne

quotes.quote: It felt as if things were literally slipping through my fingers. Things were just streaming away from me. I lost my sense of humor. I'm still looking for that.
quotes.author: Michelle Williams

quotes.quote: One question about a joke is, how well is the strangeness of the situation resolved? At 'The New Yorker', we retain a lot of incongruity, tapping the playful part of the mind - Monty Python-type stuff. We also try to use humor as a vehicle for communicating ideas. Not editorial comment, but observation.
quotes.author: Robert Mankoff

quotes.quote: I admired Stephen Daldry very much; I think he's a brilliant director, and also, I feel close to him because he has a lot of theater behind him. He's also a man of great imagination and a lovely sense of humor.
quotes.author: Max von Sydow

quotes.quote: I've always been a fan of a Johnny Carson because he was so great with an audience and not afraid of self-deprecating humor.
quotes.author: Vince Vaughn

quotes.quote: Sometimes I make myself laugh, but that's because I appreciate my sense of humor.
quotes.author: Regina Hall

quotes.quote: Every time I've done comedy in, like, traditional comedy clubs, there's always these comedians that do really well with audiences but that the other comedians hate because they're just, you know, doing kind of cheap stuff like dancing around or doing, like, very kind of base sex humor a lot, and stuff like that.
quotes.author: Aziz Ansari

quotes.quote: I think great humor lies in playing the truth of a situation. I see myself as a performer and that applies to a Greek drama or a modern comedy.
quotes.author: Brendan Coyle

quotes.quote: It's an amusing idea to some, this feminism thing - this audacious notion that women should be able to move through the world as freely, and enjoy the same inalienable rights and bodily autonomy, as men. At least, that's the impression given when feminism and feminists are all too often the targets of lazy humor.
quotes.author: Roxane Gay

quotes.quote: If you look at 'The Best Man,' there's a lot of humor in that, but I never consider that movie a comedy. I felt that it was a drama with comedic elements and comedic parts to it.
quotes.author: Malcolm D. Lee

quotes.quote: The rejection that we all take and the sadness and the aggravation and the loss of jobs and all of the things that we live through in our lives, without a sense of humor, I don't know how people make it.
quotes.author: Marlo Thomas

quotes.quote: People with a sense of humor tend to be less egocentric and more realistic in their view of the world and more humble in moments of success and less defeated in times of travail.
quotes.author: Bob Newhart

quotes.quote: The nation that complacently and fearfully allows its artists and writers to become suspected rather than respected is no longer regarded as a nation possessed with humor or depth.
quotes.author: James Thurber

quotes.quote: I get asked, 'How can you have such failures in your films?' Well, what else is life about? There's some sense of constant failure in something. Humor gives you a distance from it.
quotes.author: Alexander Payne

quotes.quote: Men love it. They have a sense of humor, whereas a lot of women are threatened or just don't get it.
quotes.author: Lara Flynn Boyle

quotes.quote: I don't really dissect comedy. Nothing kills off humor more than overanalyzing it.
quotes.author: David Steinberg

quotes.quote: I came into the 'Comedy Bang! Bang!' TV show with a level of confidence that I don't think I would've had if I hadn't been doing the podcast for three years already. I certainly had to figure out in those three years the sense of humor I wanted to do and the way to talk to celebrities without being incredibly intimidated by them.
quotes.author: Scott Aukerman

quotes.quote: As fandom grew more variegated, genzines reflected a broadening of interests, carrying personal columns of humor and reflection, science articles, amateur fiction, stylish gossip, and inevitably, thoughtful pieces on the future of fandom.
quotes.author: Gregory Benford

quotes.quote: I don't think I could ever do a network sitcom because the humor is often based on some trite circumstance. I don't want to be a part of a show where it's mostly about coming up with the jokes.
quotes.author: Sherilyn Fenn

quotes.quote: Colombian humor is very black, very sarcastic.
quotes.author: Barbet Schroeder

quotes.quote: People come up to me as I leave the stage after a performance and tell me tey saw my mother onstage with me every time I sing. I keep a sense of humor about it.
quotes.author: Lorna Luft

quotes.quote: I learned early in my career to not let myself get in the way of humor but, instead, find what is great in a talented person.
quotes.author: Tamra Davis

quotes.quote: Quite often, intent on conveying how things can go wrong for a culture (science fiction) or an individual (horror) or all of magical creation (fantasy), works of fantastika often preclude comedy, because humor gets in the way of messages of doom or struggle.
quotes.author: Paul Di Filippo

quotes.quote: Fate is like a strange, unpopular restaurant filled with odd little waiters who bring you things you never asked for and don't always like.
quotes.author: Lemony Snicket

quotes.quote: My uncle worked in emergency wards dealing with people who came in with terrible injuries. He talked about the sketch shows they would put on to lighten the atmosphere. You often find this sense of grim humor in hospitals. The injuries people are suffering are ghastly. You have to laugh at something or you'd otherwise cry.
quotes.author: Honeysuckle Weeks

quotes.quote: I don't want to be a man,"said Jace. "I want to be an angst-ridden teenager who can't confront his own inner demons and takes it out verbally on other people instead.""Well,"said Luke, "you're doing a fantastic job.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: I'm looking at some comedic horror films because I have often been accused of being too dark. I'm not dark, not compared with 'Saw' or anything like that. So I'm looking at live-action horror films, but not slasher ones - ones that have humor and maybe some social satire.
quotes.author: Henry Selick

quotes.quote: Humor that is edgy is never squeaky clean.
quotes.author: Jeff Ross

quotes.quote: Humor is always more interesting when it comes from someone who's had more than, like, five experiences.
quotes.author: Mallory Ortberg

quotes.quote: I want everything I do to have humor in it, because it seems to me that all of life has that.
quotes.author: Lawrence Kasdan

quotes.quote: I appreciate humor so much, but I'm actually not a funny girl.
quotes.author: Emmanuelle Chriqui

quotes.quote: Ad agencies do all kinds of market research that ask people what they think they want, and instead, you should be creating things that you want. If you do something and you get it, the rest of the world will get it, too. Trust your own instincts, your own intellect, and your own sense of humor.
quotes.author: George Lois

quotes.quote: My fans have great senses of humor and eat too much chocolate.
quotes.author: Christopher Moore

quotes.quote: Short fiction is like low relief. And if your story has no humor in it, then you're trying to look at something in the pitch dark. With the light of humor, it throws what you're writing into relief so that you can actually see it.
quotes.author: Elizabeth McCracken

quotes.quote: There are two MFA programs here at the University of Texas, and I read on the jury of both of them. And it's amazing to me how many really talented young writers seem to fear humor.
quotes.author: Elizabeth McCracken

quotes.quote: I'm going to do a lot of weird stuff that's not going to be like me prancing around like an insane 12-year-old. I showed everybody that side of me and I think it's time to do different stuff, even when it comes down to the type of humor. I want to do some drier, weirder stuff.
quotes.author: Andy Milonakis

quotes.quote: Conservative humor is frankly harder than liberal humor. You get points for just being liberal. You can get more points if you make fun of your own side sometimes.
quotes.author: Ted Rall

quotes.quote: The way humor's usually used in horror, it's as a pressure-release valve; without it, the drama would escalate out of all control almost immediately.
quotes.author: Stephen Graham Jones

quotes.quote: I think Canadian humor is a little less broad than American humor.
quotes.author: Scott Thompson

quotes.quote: I think the Canadian sense of humor is dryer than America's and juicier than Britain's. I think it's a cross between the two of them, really.
quotes.author: Scott Thompson

quotes.quote: Any good humor is sophomoric. 'Sophomoric' is the liberal word for funny.
quotes.author: Michael O'Donoghue

quotes.quote: For the most part, comedians are pretty friendly with each other. They always say they badmouth each other, but most of the time, they're friends. We're the only ones that can really stand our type of humor.
quotes.author: Colin Quinn

quotes.quote: Religious humor is not really my area, so I probably wouldn't do anything about that, or politics or something.
quotes.author: Chris Lilley

quotes.quote: I wish I could be as thin as Jessica Simpson. I think she looks gorgeous! I have had Jessica on my show several times, and I can tell you that girl is genuine and funny with a great self-deprecating sense of humor.
quotes.author: Rachael Ray

quotes.quote: After spending 460 days as a hostage, I did emerge a fundamentally changed person. But I think, like everyone does as they grow older and probably wiser, I can look back at my earlier life - my history, my mistakes, the joy I felt as a young woman traveling the world - with some objectivity and even some humor.
quotes.author: Amanda Lindhout

quotes.quote: I did the 'Bionic Woman,' which of course had a lot of humor in it, and that was really a function of a lot of the ad-libbing and the things that I did in it.
quotes.author: Lindsay Wagner

quotes.quote: I've always had a sick sense of humor, and I've always wanted that to permeate the music because I don't take myself seriously. I take the music seriously, but I know I'm not God's gift to anyone except my mom.
quotes.author: Josh Homme

quotes.quote: Since I became a knitting humor writer, I seem to be understood a little better - at least for the purposes of social discourse.
quotes.author: Stephanie Pearl-McPhee

quotes.quote: All God does is watch us and kill us when we get boring. We must never, ever be boring.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: Jerry Seinfeld is amazing in many ways, not the least of them his ability to find humor, and convincing us to find it, too, in the million-and-two details about modern life that under different circumstances might send us into paroxysms of rage.
quotes.author: Tom Shales

quotes.quote: Any film which views the darker side of life, which is death with a sense of humor, is very much to my taste.
quotes.author: Carter Burwell

quotes.quote: I wish there were more humor in my work than I see in it.
quotes.author: Jasper Johns

quotes.quote: Even as a kid I was never the generator of humor, but I always knew who was funny, who to hang out with.
quotes.author: Andrew Stanton

quotes.quote: I try to find humor in everything I do, because I think all great plays - even great tragedies - have enormous humor in them.
quotes.author: Marian Seldes

quotes.quote: Give a man a fire and he's warm for a day, but set fire to him and he's warm for the rest of his life.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Jingo

quotes.quote: I always felt different as a kid, and the Kinks were like, 'Yeah, we're the Kinks.' Celebrate your difference; don't be afraid of your sense of humor, or your personality, or who you are. It emboldened me.
quotes.author: Michael Weatherly

quotes.quote: I have wit in my work and a sense of humor, but I do not use irony in any way.
quotes.author: John Zorn

quotes.quote: This life's hard, but it's harder if you're stupid.
quotes.author: George V. Higgins,  The Friends of Eddie Coyle

quotes.quote: My mother was Irish; she had this great sense of humor, and both my parents loved films. There was a very vibrant discourse about politics and everything that was going on in the world where I grew up. So I was genetically predisposed to go into the performing arts.
quotes.author: Martin Donovan

quotes.quote: All I try to do is as earnestly and as acutely as I can, conceive a character and try to portray this character just honestly. If the humor is within the absurdity and the awfulness of situations, then let it be seen that way.
quotes.author: Patrick Warburton

quotes.quote: I think that humor is part of what saves us from despair.
quotes.author: John Perry Barlow

quotes.quote: As a kid, I loved 'Godot' because of the poetry and the humor and the strangeness, but then as you get older, it's much more resonant.
quotes.author: Nathan Lane

quotes.quote: My books are shelved in different places, depending on the bookstore. Sometimes they can be found in the Mystery section, sometimes in the Humor department, and occasionally even in the Literature aisle, which is somewhat astounding.
quotes.author: Carl Hiaasen

quotes.quote: I don't know if my sense of humor goes over Americans' heads.
quotes.author: Ryan Kwanten

quotes.quote: Mother humor is such a universal theme. I wrote a show called '25 Questions for a Jewish Mother.' I had people coming up to me after the show saying, 'I'm Baptist, and my mother is just like yours.'
quotes.author: Judy Gold

quotes.quote: Hope for the best, survive the worst, find humor wherever you can.
quotes.author: Claire Scovell LaZebnik

quotes.quote: We don't appreciate the value of humor sometimes.
quotes.author: Janet Evanovich

quotes.quote: You can get through very serious and sometimes horrible and sometimes embarrassing and very awkward situations with humor. It gives us a way out.
quotes.author: Janet Evanovich

quotes.quote: Reading 'Youth in Revolt' might have ruined my career because suddenly I wanted to abandon all the emotional truth of something and just go out far on a literary limb with completely implausible things that relied completely on voice and humor. And what saved me is realizing that I couldn't do that very well.
quotes.author: Rob Thomas

quotes.quote: A lot of people say, 'Hey, God doesn't have a sense of humor.' Yes, He does. God has a great sense of humor.
quotes.author: Si Robertson

quotes.quote: I don't have a disregard for my reader in humor pieces.
quotes.author: Ian Frazier

quotes.quote: I love deadlines. I like the whooshing sound they make as they fly by.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams

quotes.quote: The only way I could get comfortable around people was to make them laugh. I was an obedient girl, and humor was my one form of rebellion. I used comedy to deflect. Like, 'Hey, check out my zit!' - you know, making fun of yourself before someone else has a chance to.
quotes.author: Tina Fey

quotes.quote: I refuse to answer that question on the grounds that I don't know the answer
quotes.author: Douglas Adams

quotes.quote: Bathroom humor, fart, and poo poo humor in movies gets a laugh. It's a pretty easy audience, and that's been around for ages.
quotes.author: Selma Blair

quotes.quote: He was just trying to tease me - I knew that later - but he said he'd have to leave because it wasn't fair to have anyone in the room who was going to make fun of what he had to say. He had a good sense of humor, really.
quotes.author: Fay Wray

quotes.quote: I got my sense of humor from my grandmother. You know, my grandmother was very funny.
quotes.author: Paul Mooney

quotes.quote: Humor, for me, is really a gate of departure. It's a way of enticing a reader into a poem so that less funny things can take place later. It really is not an end in itself, but a means to an end.
quotes.author: Billy Collins

quotes.quote: I'm lucky that my real-life Mom has both a great sense of humor about herself and an amazing ability to slip into complete denial if the subject matter gets a little too close to home.
quotes.author: Cathy Guisewite

quotes.quote: When people are in the midst of really heavy stuff and still have a sense of humor, I admire that.
quotes.author: Ted Danson

quotes.quote: You learn timing on the road. You learn structure and how to read an audience. You learn so much about the business of laughter that you can't learn on a set, because it's all on you. Sometimes you bomb, and you know not to tell that joke again... You just hope people find the humor in the awkwardness.
quotes.author: Marlon Wayans

quotes.quote: As people, we're generally optimistic, no matter how disabled our lives are, and we find the humor in the darkest situations.
quotes.author: John Wells

quotes.quote: One of my pet peeves is that sometimes the talents of my band get overlooked because, and it was the same problem that Frank Zappa had, with a lot of groups that use humor, people don't realize there's a lot of craft behind the comedy.
quotes.author: Al Yankovic

quotes.quote: People, I guess, generally come to see me do stand-up with a working knowledge of my broad sense of humor on 'The Daily Show'... I don't think anyone would mistake me as an actual anchor.
quotes.author: John Oliver

quotes.quote: We get the worrywart, the hypochondriac, the money-grubbing miser, the intractable negotiator... Some would say certain of these refer to the stereotypical, or 'stage' Jew. But objectively speaking, the only crime in humor is an unfunny joke.
quotes.author: Alan King

quotes.quote: Life would be tragic if it weren't funny.
quotes.author: Stephen Hawking

quotes.quote: I'm actually a perpetual 13-year-old. I've never advanced beyond 13. Every day, tomorrow is my 14th birthday. That's my kind of humor.
quotes.author: Terry Crews

quotes.quote: There is little success where there is little laughter.
quotes.author: Andrew Carnegie

quotes.quote: I like very dry humor. I don't like things that are over the top. I like subtlety. I like things that are nonchalant. I like characters that are sort of monotone and based in dark comedy.
quotes.author: Emily Rios

quotes.quote: I love Sell Out, I think it's great. I love the jingles. The whole thing as an album is a wonderful piece of work. The cover. Everything about it. It's got humor, great songs, irony.
quotes.author: Roger Daltrey

quotes.quote: Stephen King has inspired me with his humor and honesty, and his admonition that the author's job is to tell the truth.
quotes.author: Barry Eisler

quotes.quote: Our ability to find humor in the world, to make connections between previously unconnected notions, to create new ideas, to share in a common culture: All these essentially human acts depend on memory.
quotes.author: Joshua Foer

quotes.quote: Next to power without honor, the most dangerous thing in the world is power without humor.
quotes.author: Eric Sevareid

quotes.quote: If golf wasn't enjoyable and there wasn't a lot of humor and enjoyment, even though the game is so frustrating, you would wonder why you put yourself through it.
quotes.author: Ray Romano

quotes.quote: Everybody in my family had a real sick, twisted sense of humor. Most of the jokes we make in our house, we would just never even dream of making anywhere else. Just sick, horrible stuff. That wasn't anything new to college.
quotes.author: Seth MacFarlane

quotes.quote: Whether it's viewers of the show or readers of my columns and books, I'm consistently impressed with their wit, humor and insight. That goes for about 95 percent of the audience. The other five percent are why the 'Delete' option and restraining orders were invented.
quotes.author: Richard Roeper

quotes.quote: I think sometimes my humor is extremely dry, and a lot of times I would say things that I thought were very funny but... I have a reputation of - people think of me as a very fundamentalist, humorless fellow.
quotes.author: Ian MacKaye

quotes.quote: I'm a pretty tenacious person; I get that from my mom. So sometimes, I use dark humor. I can't take myself too seriously.
quotes.author: Art Alexakis

quotes.quote: A farce, or slapstick humor, does well universally.
quotes.author: John Ratzenberger

quotes.quote: The humor is essentially dark for a cartoon and sophisticated. But at the same time, being a cartoon gives the writers more freedom than in a normal sitcom. It always pushes the line that, despite human failings, the Simpsons are really decent people.
quotes.author: Dan Castellaneta

quotes.quote: I have this idyllic love life, but my mind just won't accept that. I would like to bring a new guy home every night. I try to make humor out of that situation.
quotes.author: Jen Kirkman

quotes.quote: I think in life, the sense of humor and comedy always exists.
quotes.author: Mike Epps

quotes.quote: It's great to be able to connect parents with children both emotionally and through humor. I look forward to exploring family entertainment once again and examining the specifics of our day-to-day lives against the backdrop of an extraordinary adventure.
quotes.author: Jon Favreau

quotes.quote: The real important things are kindness and a sense of humor. I've been fortunate to have dated and could have easily married women who have those qualities, and time and circumstances didn't work out. Timing plays a big part.
quotes.author: Hill Harper

quotes.quote: That is the saving grace of humor, if you fail no one is laughing at you.
quotes.author: A. Whitney Brown

quotes.quote: I really hate sitcoms on television with canned laughter and stuff. What really makes me laugh is the real-life stuff. I've got a dry sense of humor.
quotes.author: Katie Price

quotes.quote: He can run faster than Severus Snape confronted with shampoo.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: When I was young, my favorite picture book was 'Fletcher and Zenobia,' written by Edward Gorey and illustrated by Victoria Chess. It's long out of print now, but its mix of macabre humor and 1960s psychedelia made it a perfect children's book for the times.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan

quotes.quote: My wife has a good sense of humor, and instead of calling me psychic with my novels, she simply refers to me as being 'psycho.' That's because multiple things in my books have come true.
quotes.author: Brad Thor

quotes.quote: I'll do humor about myself, I'll poke fun and everything, but that's me and I can do it to me. I think it's cruel to do it to somebody else.
quotes.author: Delta Burke

quotes.quote: I've never met a person who has more integrity than my husband. I respect that. There's his humor and intelligence, too, and he's really cute, all those things - but if you don't respect your partner, you'll get sick of him.
quotes.author: Michelle Pfeiffer

quotes.quote: There's something about Southern women that is so unique yet so universal. Strong southern women are allowed to be soft and feminine and have a sense of humor. But what I love about Southern women in particular is their universality.
quotes.author: Connie Britton

quotes.quote: My stories are very somber, so I think I need the comic ingredient. Besides, life has so much humor.
quotes.author: Manuel Puig

quotes.quote: Tony and I had a good on and off screen relationship, we are two very different people, but we did share a sense of humor, we now live in different parts of the world but when we find ourselves in the same place it is more or less as if there had been no years in between.
quotes.author: Roger Moore

quotes.quote: When you're in jail, a good friend will be trying to bail you out. A best friend will be in the cell next to you saying, 'Damn, that was fun'.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx

quotes.quote: Chance is perhaps the pseudonym of God when he does not want to sign.
quotes.author: ThÃ©ophile Gautier

quotes.quote: There's a fine line between genius and insanity. I have erased this line.
quotes.author: Oscar Levant

quotes.quote: The thing about For Better or Worse is the only thing that made me an okay director for that is that I have a sense of humor, and it was supposed to be funny.
quotes.author: Jason Alexander

quotes.quote: I have a dark sense of humor.
quotes.author: Olivia Munn

quotes.quote: Two wrongs don't make a right, but they make a good excuse.
quotes.author: Thomas Szasz

quotes.quote: I read the script and decide if a particular character looks fun to play. I look for complexity and a sense of humor. Those are crucial, real things to life.
quotes.author: Steve Buscemi

quotes.quote: The comics that are just conversing with you up there and drawing on their own life, yeah, I guess so. I guess some do political humor, some do topical humor, but the ones that I like, the ones that are appealing to me, were guys who were just talking to you about their life.
quotes.author: Ray Romano

quotes.quote: To this day, I've found that it doesn't matter what a guy looks like if he's really funny. His sense of humor makes him attractive. On the other hand, you don't hear men saying, 'No she's not pretty, but is she ever funny!'
quotes.author: Catherine O'Hara

quotes.quote: I don't think my sense of humor has changed at all; I was born with this, for better or for worse.
quotes.author: Ivan Reitman

quotes.quote: When you are courting a nice girl an hour seems like a second. When you sit on a red-hot cinder a second seems like an hour. That's relativity.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Part of my humor is the fact that I love coming out of left field. I don't want people to expect what is going to happen next.
quotes.author: Howie Mandel

quotes.quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
quotes.author: Daniel H. Wilson

quotes.quote: Daddy was hilarious. He could take the most mundane event and tell it so that we all on the floor laughing. He trained me in the joys of humor.
quotes.author: Karen DeCrow

quotes.quote: Well, don't expect us to be too impressed. We just saw Finnick Odair in his underwear.
quotes.author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

quotes.quote: Cathy was the first widely syndicated humor strip created by a woman. The strip was pretty revolutionary at the time not only because it starred a female, but also because it was so emotionally honest about all the conflicting feelings many women had in 1976.
quotes.author: Cathy Guisewite

quotes.quote: Humor can be an incredible lacerating and effective weapon. And that is the way I use it.
quotes.author: Carl Hiaasen

quotes.quote: Some humans would do anything to see if it was possible to do it. If you put a large switch in some cave somewhere, with a sign on it saying 'End-of-the-World Switch. PLEASE DO NOT TOUCH', the paint wouldn't even have time to dry.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Thief of Time

quotes.quote: If you can understand the humor in the drawing part you'll probably get the humor in the audio part.
quotes.author: Eric San

quotes.quote: I'm not an expert on the Malaysian sense of humor.
quotes.author: Ben Stiller

quotes.quote: I think what is important for things to be funny is if you the listener, or the reader, get a chance to supply the humor of it yourself.
quotes.author: Ian Frazier

quotes.quote: However, frat-boy humor is funny and it always will be.
quotes.author: Craig Kilborn

quotes.quote: But if you don't watch me, I will try and sneak in some humor. I see humor everywhere in life around me.
quotes.author: Marion Ross

quotes.quote: Death's got an Invisibility Cloak?"Harry interrupted again."So he can sneak up on people,"said Ron. "Sometimes he gets bored of running at them, flapping his arms and shrieking...
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

quotes.quote: If somebody is not on the same page with me humor wise, I can't give them that.
quotes.author: Stephan Pastis

quotes.quote: In sitcoms, the women are so beautiful, understanding and well-bred. They have humor, but sort of display it with a twinkle of the eye and not a guffaw. But there's no juice in that for me.
quotes.author: Bea Arthur

quotes.quote: You know the world is going crazy when the best rapper is a white guy, the best golfer is a black guy, the tallest guy in the NBA is Chinese, the Swiss hold the America's Cup, France is accusing the U.S. of arrogance, Germany doesn't want to go to war, and the three most powerful men in America are named "Bush", "Dick", and "Colin."Need I say more?
quotes.author: Chris Rock

quotes.quote: Athletes tend to have less of a sense of humor than most people. They are heroes to so many. That might be part of it.
quotes.author: Jeff Ross

quotes.quote: Never memorize something that you can look up.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: It's odd how violence and humor so often go together, isn't it?
quotes.author: Dan Simmons

quotes.quote: With reporting, if you work hard, you can usually pull something out. But writing humor doesn't respond to working hard, necessarily. I mean, you could just sit there and look at the page all day and maybe something will come.
quotes.author: Ian Frazier

quotes.quote: I really love middle-grade. Middle-grade books have a little more of a magical, light-hearted feel. You can be a little bit more quirky, you can have a little more humor. It doesn't get so dark and deep.
quotes.author: James Dashner

quotes.quote: Is it true that you shouted at Professor Umbridge?""Yes.""You called her a liar?""Yes.""You told her He Who Must Not Be Named is back?""Yes.""Have a biscuit, Potter.
quotes.author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

quotes.quote: Negative humor is forgotten immediately. It's the stuff that makes us feel better about our lives that lives long. Much more satisfying. Enter children's books.
quotes.author: Berkeley Breathed

quotes.quote: My dad instilled in me a great sense of humor. I wasn't bullied at school because my outward attitude was confident, and that helps.
quotes.author: Warwick Davis

quotes.quote: I think that sense of humor is important in marriage. A sense of humor gets people through marriage.
quotes.author: Connie Britton

quotes.quote: The great thing about 'Weeds' is that everything we do is never quite serious enough to be taken seriously. It always has humor behind it, and it think it makes it definitely more fun for the audience.
quotes.author: Alexander Gould

quotes.quote: The waltz is a very important part of my life. It's a very important way for me to express my positiveness, bringing humor to the world.
quotes.author: Andre Rieu

quotes.quote: Every black film feels like it's Tyler Perry, and that just needs to stop. But people seem to slowly be looking for what else is out there - 'Is there something else besides this type of humor?' 'I'm tired of seeing men in dresses.'
quotes.author: Issa Rae

quotes.quote: Be fun! I don't like homes or rooms that don't have a sense of humor or have some sense of whimsy or a personality. Your home should reflect who you are, and what you love. I would never have something in my home because it's the thing to have. I have to love it and it needs some connection to me.
quotes.author: Bryan Batt

quotes.quote: Going to church doesn't make you a Christian any more than going to a garage makes you an automobile.
quotes.author: Billy Sunday,  Billy Sunday, the Man and His Message: With His Own Words Which Have Won Thousands for Christ

quotes.quote: People in Russia adapt to misery by a deep, deep humor.
quotes.author: Ian Frazier

quotes.quote: If the world were merely seductive, that would be easy. If it were merely challenging, that would be no problem. But I arise in the morning torn between a desire to improve the world and a desire to enjoy the world. This makes it hard to plan the day.
quotes.author: E.B. White

quotes.quote: Bands from Akron have a sense of humor and don't tend to take themselves too seriously.
quotes.author: Dan Auerbach

quotes.quote: If you look at the game and everything, it's not quite like looking at an animated film, because that's total character. This, this is really movement, but it's got funny little things if you look for the humor. They're actually getting to the character.
quotes.author: Don Bluth

quotes.quote: I often have said that to be a college president, you need a thick skin, a good sense of humor, and nerves like sewer pipes.
quotes.author: Gordon Gee

quotes.quote: I love 'Dexter.' The dark sense of humor is wonderful.
quotes.author: Stephen J. Cannell

quotes.quote: I can't live without a sense of humor. I need to be laughing and entertained at all times.
quotes.author: Carlos Ponce

quotes.quote: Humor has bailed me out of more tight situations than I can think of. If you go with your instincts and keep your humor, creativity follows. With luck, success comes, too.
quotes.author: Jimmy Buffett

quotes.quote: There was a time I was very much blaming the way I felt on L.A, that it was a vacuum of creativity, of humor or anything organic, and I was really angry at the place. But then today I feel completely different - I love L.A.!
quotes.author: Naomi Watts

quotes.quote: I'm a Larry David fan, right? And it seems to me that Jewish history from the Talmud on has been a self-deprecating, self-critical kind of humor.
quotes.author: Peter Eisenman

quotes.quote: There's a hysterical, tired sense of humor that comes after working 14 hours a day, six days a week. I like those things because they take the pressure off the constant stress.
quotes.author: Tom Berenger

quotes.quote: I think God has a sense of humor, and the way my lessons come from God is very funny. I have to laugh at myself even if it's a tough lesson.
quotes.author: Yvette Nicole Brown

quotes.quote: I don't think humor is forced upon my universe; it's a part of it.
quotes.author: Manuel Puig

quotes.quote: Reader, suppose you were an idiot. And suppose you were a member of Congress. But I repeat myself.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I don't feel that I'm strictly Danish; I don't feel that my sense of humor is strictly Danish or my human sensibility is strictly Danish.
quotes.author: Susanne Bier

quotes.quote: I love puns. I've been known to turn the car around just to take advantage of a good pun situation. It really is the highest form of humor.
quotes.author: Karin Slaughter

quotes.quote: People who know me know I have a sense of humor that can really push the envelope.
quotes.author: Carmen Electra

quotes.quote: I love the vulgar. I kind of have the humor of a 17-year-old boy.
quotes.author: Judy Gold

quotes.quote: It means 'Shadowhunters: Looking Better in Black Than the Widows of our Enemies Since 1234'.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: Every time I do a movie like 'Finding Neverland' or 'Chocolat' or 'Shakespeare' in Love,' we deal with the creative process, but there's humor and fun along the way. I always love that kind of movie.
quotes.author: Harvey Weinstein

quotes.quote: Philip Larkin has a tough honesty and sense of humor that I find irresistible, as a contemporary poet.
quotes.author: Robert Morgan

quotes.quote: Do feminists have a sense of humor? Yes.
quotes.author: Gloria Allred

quotes.quote: Substitute 'damn' every time you're inclined to write 'very;' your editor will delete it and the writing will be just as it should be.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: 'The Sundial' is written with the kind of humor that would make a guillotine laugh.
quotes.author: Victor LaValle

quotes.quote: I like dark humor. My favorite movie of all time is 'Harold and Maude.'
quotes.author: Leslie Mann

quotes.quote: I try to cope with everything through humor.
quotes.author: Gail Porter

quotes.quote: I can't not find humor in elements of most parts of life, but at the same time nothing ever seems perpetually funny to me.
quotes.author: Greg Kinnear

quotes.quote: Humor can inform and break down stigma, which is a huge issue in the military.
quotes.author: Garry Trudeau

quotes.quote: Brits have a better sense of humor in most ways. It's darker, more cutting.
quotes.author: Stephan Pastis

quotes.quote: Humor reminds you, when you're flattened by sorrow, that you're still human.
quotes.author: Elizabeth McCracken

quotes.quote: You write the way you think about the world. My motto in times of trouble - and I'm speaking of life, not writing - is 'no humor too black.'
quotes.author: Elizabeth McCracken

quotes.quote: I have the humor of a 9-year-old boy, and sometimes I've had laughing fits on-air.
quotes.author: Megyn Kelly

quotes.quote: Do you remember back at the hotel when you promised that if we lived, you'd get dressed up in a nurse's outfit and give me a sponge bath?"asked Jace."It was Simon who promised you the sponge bath.""As soon as I'm back on my feet, handsome,"said Simon."I knew we should have left you a rat.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: I think the thrust of any child is to try to fit in and be part of it. And I can't tell you how many times my humor, you know, what I thought was humor ended up making me the outsider. Like I'd be, I go, 'It's a joke.' And they'd go, 'Well, what was funny?' And they just thought I was insane.
quotes.author: Howie Mandel

quotes.quote: Never go to bed mad. Stay up and fight.
quotes.author: Phyllis Diller

quotes.quote: The biggest void that people can have in their lives is a sense of humor. Spending your life with someone who doesn't have that wouldn't be palatable.
quotes.author: Howie Mandel

quotes.quote: I do not want people to be very agreeable, as it saves me the trouble of liking them a great deal.
quotes.author: Jane Austen,  Jane Austen's Letters

quotes.quote: My family has been amazing, and they understand how blessed I am. They've been able to keep my sense of humor.
quotes.author: Karen Duffy

quotes.quote: Sure, I am funny and have a good sense of humor. Mostly, though, I just tell the truth. The internal dialogue people have in their heads - I just write it.
quotes.author: Kara Swisher

quotes.quote: I love people who make me laugh. I honestly think it's the thing I like most, to laugh. It cures a multitude of ills. It's probably the most important thing in a person.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: Good acting is thinking in front of the camera. I just do that and apply a sense of humor to it. You have to trust the audience to get it.
quotes.author: Charles Grodin

quotes.quote: So many tangles in life are ultimately hopeless that we have no appropriate sword other than laughter.
quotes.author: Gordon W. Allport

quotes.quote: I like doing comedy, I like doing drama. Naturally I like to do, I like doing dramas, I like conflict, and when I do a comedy, you know, I've found that, like, romantic comedy is the trickiest one, because often it's neither: it's not romantic and it's not funny. So, like, I like a comedy that's biting. It's biting humor or really quirky humor.
quotes.author: Matt Dillon

quotes.quote: My dad was a very funny man - he's the one who taught me life would be awfully hard without humor! I'm sure his Irish wit in some way influenced my decision to become an actress.
quotes.author: Joan Cusack

quotes.quote: Most of the people in my family were pretty funny. Everyone had a good sense of humor. I came to California right after college, wanting to be a musician.
quotes.author: Andy Kindler

quotes.quote: Using no control and using humor will build a relationship and make a dent to where the client puts the counselor in their quality world and then begins to relate and seek out the counselor. Effective therapy begins with the acceptance of the therapist into the client's quality world.
quotes.author: William Glasser

quotes.quote: Throughout history, great leaders have known the power of humor.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: It is characteristic of all deep human problems that they are not to be approached without some humor and some bewilderment.
quotes.author: Freeman Dyson

quotes.quote: It has always surprised me how little attention philosophers have paid to humor, since it is a more significant process of mind than reason. Reason can only sort out perceptions, but the humor process is involved in changing them.
quotes.author: Edward de Bono

quotes.quote: In prehistoric times, mankind often had only two choices in crisis situations: fight or flee. In modern times, humor offers us a third alternative; fight, flee - or laugh.
quotes.author: Robert Orben

quotes.quote: I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours.
quotes.author: Jerome K. Jerome

quotes.quote: I don't need someone with a hot body. He can be fat or overweight and have a belly. It's very much about style and substance and humor, interest, curiosity and really being smart.
quotes.author: Kate Walsh

quotes.quote: Poor David Hume is dying fast, but with more real cheerfulness and good humor and with more real resignation to the necessary course of things, than any whining Christian ever dyed with pretended resignation to the will of God.
quotes.author: Adam Smith

quotes.quote: The comic is the perception of the opposite; humor is the feeling of it.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco

quotes.quote: The schizophrenic has no sense of humor. His world is a constantly daunting, unfriendly place.
quotes.author: Bob Newhart

quotes.quote: As an actor, I'm attracted to drama; as a director, it's humor - because it's the story of my life, and I can't be that serious about it. Being alone is a big theme in all my movies, both as a director and as an actress.
quotes.author: Jodie Foster

quotes.quote: The combination of landing the biggest interview of my career and having a drill in my back reminds me that God only gives us what we can handle and that it helps to have a good sense of humor when we run smack into the absurdity of life.
quotes.author: Robin Roberts

quotes.quote: When I teach the formal curriculum, I have the chance to think about it ahead of time. I can rehearse it. I can illustrate it with self-deprecating humor and humble-sounding personal disclosure. I can try to make it comes out just right.
quotes.author: John Ortberg

quotes.quote: Denzel Washington has a great sense of humor. He did all those 'Nutty Professor' movies.
quotes.author: Seth MacFarlane

quotes.quote: I just am a snob when it comes to humor.
quotes.author: Courteney Cox

quotes.quote: Professional comedians, surprisingly, have a lack of humor. They're insensitive to the insanity of our times.
quotes.author: Mort Sahl

quotes.quote: It never seems to occur to some people, that, like beauty, a sense of humor may sometimes be fatal.
quotes.author: Edgar Rice Burroughs

quotes.quote: I didn't think that anything is beyond humor - not profane humor, but a good, honest approach to humor.
quotes.author: Mort Sahl

quotes.quote: Humor is the ability to see three sides to one coin.
quotes.author: Ned Rorem

quotes.quote: If someone is genuine, compassionate and kind, that is a turn-on. A sense of humor is a huge turn on, and that goes hand in hand with intelligence.
quotes.author: Jennifer Nettles

quotes.quote: Malachi scowled. "I don't remember the Clave inviting you into the Glass City, Magnus Bane.""They didn't,"Magnus said. "Your wards are down.""Really?"the Consul's voice dripped sarcasm. "I hadn't noticed."Magnus looked concerned. "That's terrible. Someone should have told you."He glanced at Luke. "Tell him the wards are down.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

quotes.quote: I love the idea of things being strict and things being uniform. That's the reason why I surround each collection with humor or irony. I want to make sure that it's not too serious and that there is some element that throws it off because otherwise that would make it really boring. There's always a story that's somewhat fantastical.
quotes.author: Thom Browne

quotes.quote: I was a product of a divorced family and I used humor as a weapon to combat sadness. I used comedy to make my mother laugh in light of the darkness that she faced, and to me it became a very powerful tool at a very young age, at six. I saw how therapeutic it could be.
quotes.author: Josh Gad

quotes.quote: I think it's part of the responsibility of an artist to shock, to upset, to make people think differently, and to surprise people. And that's where the good humor is, if there's a surprise and there's something unexpected. Something that's not normal, not in the realm of general living expectations.
quotes.author: Bill Plympton

quotes.quote: Humor is probably the most significant characteristics of the human mind. Far more significant than reason. In fact, reason is actually a very cheap commodity.
quotes.author: Edward de Bono

quotes.quote: What's great about the geek spirit is that life never seems to stop us, and they never seem to kill our enthusiasm, our optimism and our hunger to experience the world. We keep our sense of humor, we protect our dignity, we talk to our friends about the experience and then we start again fresh the very next day.
quotes.author: Paul Feig

quotes.quote: I think the humor of double puns is incredible.
quotes.author: Richard Lederer

quotes.quote: I find humor to be the most attractive characteristic, but I certainly won't cancel anything out, considering when you love someone you love someone, and sometimes you just can't explain it.
quotes.author: Zoey Deutch

quotes.quote: To me, Ann Romney sounds like a better candidate than her husband. She put her MS into remission through horseback riding, alternative therapies, and a healthy diet. She knows how to pace herself. She has a sense of humor and an innate honesty, and her hair moves in the wind. Maybe she should run.
quotes.author: Patti Davis

quotes.quote: What the hell is that?"I laughed."It's my fox hat.""Your fox hat?""Yeah, Pudge. My fox hat.""Why are you wearing your fox hat?"I asked."Because no one can catch the motherfucking fox.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: You know those things that you throw the twigs into and it spits them out? That's what I do. The branches are like life, and I throw them into my head and some of it comes out as humor.
quotes.author: Steven Wright

quotes.quote: In truth, politeness is artificial good humor, it covers the natural want of it, and ends by rendering habitual a substitute nearly equivalent to the real virtue.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: The planet is fine. The people are fucked.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: Anybody with a sense of humor is going to put on my album and laugh from beginning to end.
quotes.author: Eminem

quotes.quote: Well, I'm not kissing the mundane,"said Jace. "I'd rather stay down here and rot.""Forever?"said Simon. "Forever's an awfully long time."Jace raised his eyebrows. "I knew it,"he said. "You want to kiss me, don't you?
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

quotes.quote: My type of humor is me not caring whether people know what I'm talking about or not.
quotes.author: John Hodgman

quotes.quote: In a way, a lot of my humor comes from presenting things that are dramatic or shocking and then people not having socially appropriate responses, having people denying the drama by failing to react to it, and that's a really classic form of humor.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk

quotes.quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
quotes.author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield

quotes.quote: When a chick has a sense of humor, there's nothing more attractive.
quotes.author: Dylan O'Brien

quotes.quote: Congratulations, you have a sense of humor. And to those who didn't: Go stick your head in the mud.
quotes.author: Jesse Ventura

quotes.quote: My mom taught me the power of love. I learned to focus on the long-term big picture from my father. His sense of humor and light-hearted approach always make me smile. My husband is a pivotal anchor in my life. His influence encourages me to be independent and take risks.
quotes.author: Padmasree Warrior

quotes.quote: If you're feeling blue, lock yourself in a room, stand in front of a mirror, and dance - and laugh at yourself and be sexy. Dance the silliest and ugliest you've ever danced. Make fun of yourself and try to recover your sense of humor.
quotes.author: Salma Hayek

quotes.quote: I believe that singing is the key to long life, a good figure, a stable temperament, increased intelligence, new friends, super self-confidence, heightened sexual attractiveness, and a better sense of humor.
quotes.author: Brian Eno

quotes.quote: I will say that as I get older and calmer and quieter in my own self, the one quality in a woman that I find more and more attractive is kindness. A sense of adventure and humor is important too, but I truly find kindness and consideration for others to be the most attractive thing in anyone.
quotes.author: Colin Farrell

quotes.quote: When his life was ruined, his family killed, his farm destroyed, Job knelt down on the ground and yelled up to the heavens, "Why god? Why me?"and the thundering voice of God answered, There's just something about you that pisses me off.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Storm of the Century: An Original Screenplay

quotes.quote: Through humor, you can soften some of the worst blows that life delivers. And once you find laughter, no matter how painful your situation might be, you can survive it.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: There is a theory which states that if ever anyone discovers exactly what the Universe is for and why it is here, it will instantly disappear and be replaced by something even more bizarre and inexplicable. There is another theory which states that this has already happened.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Restaurant at the End of the Universe

quotes.quote: Where is human nature so weak as in the bookstore?
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: A strong sense of humor, a really awesome personality, and maturity is also really important in a boyfriend. I tend to only be attracted to older guys for that reason. I just love guys who have a really strong sense of who they are.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gillies

quotes.quote: My legacy would be that you don't have to give up anything. You can be chic but have a sense of humor, you can be sexy but comfortable, you can be timeless but fresh.
quotes.author: Michael Kors

quotes.quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
quotes.author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

quotes.quote: I generally avoid temptation unless I can't resist it.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.quote: One of the things that binds us as a family is a shared sense of humor.
quotes.author: Ralph Fiennes

quotes.quote: There are two motives for reading a book; one, that you enjoy it; the other, that you can boast about it.
quotes.author: Bertrand Russell

quotes.quote: In the household in which I was raised, the themes were pretty simple. 'Work hard. Don't quit. Be appreciative, be thankful, be grateful, be respectful. Also, never whine, never complain. And always, for crying out loud, keep a sense of humor.'
quotes.author: Michael Keaton

quotes.quote: If a cluttered desk is a sign of a cluttered mind, of what, then, is an empty desk a sign?
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: OK, in all seriousness, I would say I couldn't be in a relationship without equality, generosity, integrity, spirit, kindness and humor. And awesomeness.
quotes.author: Jennifer Aniston

quotes.quote: I think kids want the same thing from a book that adults want - a fast-paced story, characters worth caring about, humor, surprises, and mystery. A good book always keeps you asking questions, and makes you keep turning pages so you can find out the answers.
quotes.author: Rick Riordan

quotes.quote: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. Then quit. No use being a damn fool about it.
quotes.author: W.C. Fields

quotes.quote: Some people say my humor focuses too much on stereotypes. It doesn't. It focuses on facts.
quotes.author: Sarah Silverman

quotes.quote: You can turn painful situations around through laughter. If you can find humor in anything, even poverty, you can survive it.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: I could not tread these perilous paths in safety, if I did not keep a saving sense of humor.
quotes.author: Horatio Nelson

quotes.quote: We are really living the American dream, to be a successful brand in the States and in Europe and to steep ourselves in our heritage. But we do it with a sense of humor. We don't take ourselves too seriously in fashion.
quotes.author: Tommy Hilfiger

quotes.quote: It's not true that I had nothing on. I had the radio on.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: I always thought the biggest failing of Americans was their lack of irony. They are very serious there! Naturally, there are exceptions... the Jewish, Italian, and Irish humor of the East Coast.
quotes.author: Colin Firth

quotes.quote: If it gets laughs, it's funny.
quotes.author: Rachel Dratch

quotes.quote: Humor distorts nothing, and only false gods are laughed off their earthly pedestals.
quotes.author: Agnes Repplier

quotes.quote: I think God has a tremendous sense of humor.
quotes.author: Rainn Wilson

quotes.quote: I did not attend his funeral, but I sent a nice letter saying I approved of it.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I've learned to have a sense of humor about myself. Lord knows everyone else does!
quotes.author: Debbie Gibson

quotes.quote: Humor is just another defense against the universe.
quotes.author: Mel Brooks

quotes.quote: Comedy, we may say, is society protecting itself - with a smile.
quotes.author: J. B. Priestley

quotes.quote: A joke's a very serious thing.
quotes.author: Charles Churchill

quotes.quote: My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive; and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Your attitude is like a box of crayons that color your world. Constantly color your picture gray, and your picture will always be bleak. Try adding some bright colors to the picture by including humor, and your picture begins to lighten up.
quotes.author: Allen Klein

quotes.quote: Smiling is definitely one of the best beauty remedies. If you have a good sense of humor and a good approach to life, that's beautiful.
quotes.author: Rashida Jones

quotes.quote: I love a man with a great sense of humor and who is intelligent - a man who has a great smile. He has to make me laugh. I like a man who is very ambitious and driven and who has a good heart and makes me feel safe. I like a man who is very strong and independent and confident - that is very sexy - but at the same time, he's very kind to people.
quotes.author: Nicole Scherzinger

quotes.quote: I have never believed much in luck, and my sense of humor has tended to walk on the dark side.
quotes.author: Hunter S. Thompson

quotes.quote: Procrastination is the art of keeping up with yesterday.
quotes.author: Don Marquis

quotes.quote: Happiness is a warm puppy.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: I don't think that I could have survived in my family without a naughty sense of humor; yeah, absolutely. I think my brother and I both get our senses of humor from our parents. I mean, my mother was absolutely hilarious and foul. She had the most ridiculously off color sense of humor, so that was sort of what we grew up with.
quotes.author: Rachael MacFarlane

quotes.quote: It is hard enough to remember my opinions, without also remembering my reasons for them!
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Accept who you are. Unless you're a serial killer.
quotes.author: Ellen DeGeneres,  Seriously... I'm Kidding

quotes.quote: If we went by the world's definition of who I'm supposed to be because I look weird... 'Well, surely, this guy can't have a productive life, surely, he doesn't have a sense of humor. Surely, he can't love life.' We stereotype people in this world. And so... if the world thinks you're not good enough, it's a lie, you know. Get a second opinion.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: I don't know the question, but sex is definitely the answer.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: So once I thought of the villain with a sense of humor, I began to think of a name and the name "the Joker" immediately came to mind. There was the association with the Joker in the deck of cards, and I probably yelled literally, 'Eureka!' because I knew I had the name and the image at the same time.
quotes.author: Jerry Robinson

quotes.quote: When humor works, it works because it's clarifying what people already feel. It has to come from someplace real.
quotes.author: Tina Fey

quotes.quote: I want someone who can keep me on my toes, has a good sense of humor and a good heart.
quotes.author: Carmen Electra

quotes.quote: I'm direct, I'm unpretentious and I'm pretty dogged, and I hope I've got a capacity to laugh at myself and not take myself too seriously.
quotes.author: John Howard

quotes.quote: There are so many things to talk about between black people, Hispanic people, white people, gay people, men, women, it's all based on fear. We all have fears, this thing that stops us from embracing as we are one. We are never going to be one. People are messed up, but humor lets us see how ignorant we can be.
quotes.author: Marlon Wayans

quotes.quote: Suspense is very important. Even though this is humor and they're short stories, that theory of building suspense is still there.
quotes.author: Sergio Aragones
